# Blocks the manual marks ```rust``` but which are, in fact, fragments:
# continuations that reuse a binding from an earlier block on the same page,
# or bare item declarations shown for reference. They cannot type-check on
# their own, and `tests/manual_snippets.rs` skips them.
#
# Recorded 2026-08-16 (ticgit c8d771eb). The durable fix is to mark each one
# ```rust,fragment``` in the page itself, which `tests/manual_conformance.rs`
# already accepts. That edit changes page BODIES and therefore invalidates
# `synced_hash`, so it must ride a `write-diataxis-manual` sync run with a
# `manual/log.md` entry rather than being hand-applied — the same mistake
# commit 005a9ad made when the 0.3.1 release edited bodies without re-hashing.
# Until then, this table keeps the lane honest instead of red.
#
# Format, one per line:
#   <repo-relative page path> :: <first non-blank line of the block>
#
# An entry covers every ```rust``` block on that page whose first non-blank
# line matches exactly; three blocks in your-first-archive.md share
# `fn main() -> Result<(), ArchiveError> {`, and one entry covers all three.
#
# `fragment_allowlist_is_not_stale` fails on any entry that no longer matches
# a block, so this table can only shrink: mark a block in the page, and its
# entry here must be deleted in the same change.
